# R as a Calculator {#sec-calculator}

Before anything else, R is simply a very good calculator. Type an expression, press Enter, and it answers — with the result wrapped in `[1]`, R's way of labeling item number one of your answer.

```r
5 + 3 * 2
```

```
[1] 11
```

## The essentials

`+` `-` `*` `/` work as expected. Use `^` for "to the power of," and parentheses `()` to control order of operations, exactly as in arithmetic class.

## A few built-in functions

| Function | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `sqrt(x)` | Square root | `sqrt(144)` → `12` |
| `abs(x)` | Absolute value | `abs(-7)` → `7` |
| `round(x, n)` | Round to `n` decimal places | `round(3.14159, 2)` → `3.14` |

The box below evaluates real arithmetic in your browser — type an expression and press **Run**, or click one of the examples.

<span class="example" data-expr="round(3.14159, 2)">round(3.14159, 2)</span>
